A mirrored branch gives Vref = Veb + I*R2 (about 0.67 + 0.21 = 0.88 V). Partial PTAT compensation brings TC to about 1300 ppm/C. Budget: three branches of 0.6 uA plus about 0.2 uA of start-up, roughly 2.8 uA at 125 C, which is about 5.5 uW at 1.98 V. Long-L mirrors handle line regulation and PSRR."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":     (0.6e-6, 0.3e-6, 0.9e-6),   # core branch current at 27C (PTAT)
    "K":     (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),           # beta-multiplier width ratio M2/M1
    "gmidn": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),         # NMOS pair: subthreshold
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),          # PMOS mirror
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Vptat": (0.21, 0.15, 0.26),         # I*R2 PTAT term added to Veb
    "Mq":    (2, 1, 8),                  # PNP multiplicity
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = max(2, int(round(p["K"]))); Mq = max(1, int(round(p["Mq"])))
    Ln = p["Ln"]; Lp = p["Lp"]

    # --- NMOS beta-multiplier pair ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, I, vds=0.5)
    W1 = m1.W; W2 = K * W1
    # solve Vgs2 of the wide device (with source degeneration -> vsb = dV) for the same current
    dV = 0.07
    for _ in range(4):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.2
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            idm = lut.op("n", W2, Ln, mid, 0.4, vsb=dV)["Id"]
            if idm > I: hi = mid
            else: lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        dV = max(0.02, m1.vgs - vgs2)
    R1 = dV / I
    R2 = p["Vptat"] / I

    # --- PMOS mirror (diode M3, outputs M4 -> n1, M5 -> output branch) ---
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # core
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "n1", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "n1", "s2", "vss", "nfet", W2, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "vss", R1)
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # output branch: Vref = Veb + I*R2
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=Mq)

    # --- start-up: weak pull-up on x, sensed by n1; x high pulls pg low ---
    n.M("MS1a", "xa", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS1b", "x", "vss", "xa", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS2", "x", "n1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 4 * W1, Ln)
    n.M("MS3", "pg", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.C("CS", "x", "vss", 50e-15)

    # --- predictions ---
    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (I / Mq))
    vref = veb + p["Vptat"]
    slope = (veb - 1.2) / 300.0 + 3 * 0.0862e-3 + p["Vptat"] / 300.0   # V/K
    tc = abs(slope) * 165.0 / (vref * 165.0) * 1e6
    i_st = 0.2e-6
    power = 1.98 * (3 * I * 398.0 / 300.0 + i_st)
    rout = 1.0 / max(mp.gds, 1e-15)
    line_reg = (R2 + 1.0 / (Mq * 40 * I)) / rout + 0.02
    psrr = db(rout / (R2 + UT / I * 1.0)) if rout > R2 else 6.0
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
